# Swagger UI 5.35.0

Vendored from the official `swagger-ui-dist@5.35.0` npm package. Only the browser bundle,
stylesheet, Apache-2.0 license and NOTICE are included. No runtime CDN is required.
Configuration: https://swagger.io/docs/open-source-tools/swagger-ui/usage/configuration/
The local integration disables external validation and persistent authorization.
`provenance.json` records the upstream package integrity and SHA-256 of each copied file;
the diagnostic regression suite verifies those hashes.
